states.text:
I. Translate a decay fraction into a rate

A positive model retains 80% of its amount every three time units. Find its constant continuous rate k and its half-life. State the model assumption.

Get a hint

exp(3k)=0.8; a half-life H satisfies exp(kH)=1/2.

Show explained solution

Assuming exact exponential decay with constant k, k=ln(0.8)/3≈−0.0743812 per time unit. The half-life is ln(1/2)/k≈9.318851 time units. Dividing −0.2 by 3 gives a finite-fraction approximation, not the exact continuous rate. These conclusions depend on the exponential model; one observed retention interval alone would not establish it.
